text: Hulisimekit rusastan arans visai mutk gorzo gotarjerkeryak harakatineri, ait tevum hahe harakatineri hamar, uji mece matel nurkark. Aizham nerang nahkan meknele petke nahapes gran sven ru aidi, bet자인 havelvazi minchozov. Mutki haite petke nerka etsel vot shoot kan inasun or, ye vot ush kan jotanasun erkujam minchev sahmanahatele. Yete arkaen arta karkanga manknech orinak merzavorazgakani mah kamtsan arhi vandutsun. Haite karlie nerkait snel nünisk mincheft mutkit çors jam araç. Grandsmanan thackuman rajesht e nsel anz nagraintavial nere, nerkait snel lusanakar, nsel ay sine pataka, nahates vohmutki, yev yelki amsa tavere, iskvoros debkerum naev dzainain nemuş, nahnakankin sa chapakan uyunakanatsman nepatakov. Sahmana hatalis nahkinipes karogen irakana tvel naev ken sa chapakan slugum ner, lusanakarahanum yev matnahet kerivertsunum. Nor karkachitaratsvun belarusikara katsneri, minčev veetsarekan yerehaneri, rusastan visaev muth gorcoch anzans, inšpesnaev divanagitakan yev vorosh paštunakan karkavicekunecoch anzansfera. Rusastani ishanutsian gnahatmam baist po pohocean napatakne tvainatsnel migracion veeras korutunam. Ru aidi havelvatsimichotov yurakanchur otarjerkira tsuhamar zeva vorwumet vain profil, vore hetagayum karoge gor tsatsvel petakan tsarayutsunis oktavelis, jev migratsioon tarber gor tsant hasnerum. Rusa stani pet dumayum ang gatsuman vor nor kar kamitvace vodstel ra tsutsichochendot nel stertzelun, ail mut ki gor tsant hasnaveli verehaskeli dartsnelun, anorina kan migraţi hai riskeren vazetsnelun, jev tavyalneri stugum naragatsnelun.
